title: Add Android ROM restart
changes: Add a confirmation-based Restart ROM action that waits for the game worker to pause, saves cartridge data, resets machine, audio and input, and retains the live session on save failure.
validation: Serial Android host Rust tests passed: 32 passed and 2 ignored, including synthetic save preservation, clean reboot and failed-write isolation in android-rom-restart-tests-_mcmcd54.
ARM64 Docker build and 27 Kotlin tests passed in android-rom-restart-apk-f4ncn0cz; updated the connected moto g34 5G with adb install -r.
limitations: The restart menu and real game behavior were not manually exercised on the physical device; progress not saved inside the game is lost on restart.
